items.text: Safer JSON saves — bookmarks, settings, page data, finders, colors, and the health/preview caches now write through a temporary file and rename. A crash or power loss during save is much less likely to leave a half-written JSON file on disk.
Keyboard reset confirm — the English confirmation prompt for Reset all shortcuts no longer shows a missing translation key.
Default favicon prefetch — first-run icon downloads now run in small batches (up to eight at a time), matching the Config prefetch route, so startup stays responsive on large bookmark sets.
